title: Sunlit Conversation / 日光下的闲谈
melodyDesign: Upbeat D-B neighbour motif; dotted-quarter answers, prepared9-8 and4-3 suspensions, stepwise links and contrasting B register; varied return and tonic cadence. No random pitch/timing.
gatePolicy: Global mono lead across all strings; only explicitly prepared suspensions cross harmony boundaries. All comp releases end before a barline.
leadLayer: Vel02Pick (actual light picked recording, NOT brightEQ on fingerstyle)
room: Dry recorded room only; no added delay or reverb
dynamics: Four 2bar sentences within each8bar phrase; small planned rise and cadence relaxation, no random gain

audit.scope: Objective source/score/PCM validation; no listening approval

sourceClarity.method: Original48kHz sources, same onset threshold2.5% peak minus6ms; first300ms Welch4096 detrendconstant. 2.5–6.2kHz PSD sum / total PSD sum, independent of level; no EQ.
sourceClarity.interpretation: Objective changed source layer/spectral evidence; not a listening-quality approval
